entity.name: Vardum Technology Pty Ltd
entity.description: Australian company building Vardum Messenger, an open-source end-to-end encrypted messenger.

projects.name: Vardum Messenger
projects.description: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) end-to-end encrypted messenger for iPhone and Android. Post-quantum hybrid encryption (X25519 + ML-KEM-768), no phone number sign-up, sealed-sender delivery and its own relay and call servers. Funding goes to an independent cryptographic audit, planned for early 2027, and the fixes that follow.

channels.description: Bank transfer to Vardum Technology Pty Ltd. Details on request.

plans.name: Independent cryptographic audit
plans.description: Third-party audit of the encryption protocol, apps and relay, plus fixes and a public report.
